answer: Proof of Stake acts as a river of capital flowing through a quartz substrate of validator nodes to secure the network. By requiring agents to lock assets atop a mesa of cryptographic certainty, the system enforces a high economic barrier. An attacker attempting to create infinite identities must acquire a proportional share of total stake, forcing them to internalize the cost of asset devaluation if the protocol fails, thereby rendering mass Sybil infiltration prohibitively expensive.
